applets.name: StandaloneBase
applets.title: Standalone Base
applets.desc: Local LMS-compatible infrastructure services for Squeezebox Radio.
applets.changes: Automatically merge GitHub applet releases into the local catalog, preserve device settings and local packages, and offer a manual update check.
applets.creator: Sjoerd Brandsma

applets.name: StandaloneRadio
applets.title: Standalone Radio
applets.desc: Standalone internet radio playback for Logitech Squeezebox Radio.
applets.changes: Improve RadioFeeds search, playlist resolution, HLS playback and metadata, and station artwork.
applets.creator: Sjoerd Brandsma

applets.name: SpotifyConnect
applets.title: Spotify Connect
applets.desc: Standalone Spotify Connect playback for Logitech Squeezebox Radio.
applets.changes: Add Disabled, Manual, and Always On Spotify service lifecycle modes with safe recovery.
applets.creator: Sjoerd Brandsma

applets.name: QobuzConnect
applets.title: Qobuz Connect
applets.desc: Qobuz Connect playback for Logitech Squeezebox Radio. Requires StandaloneBase.
applets.changes: Adds Disabled, Manual and Always On lifecycle modes with safe supervision and detailed status.
applets.creator: Sjoerd Brandsma
